source: 5.9 L four, 35 PS (25.7 kW) at 950 rpm, 300-1000 rpm range; four speeds plus reverse, gate change; chain final drive; hand brake on 30 cm rear drums; water-cooled foot brake on the chain drive's countershaft; 70-75 km/h (Wikipedia, citing Eckermann). Gearbox ratios and the bevel ratio (with the 2.13 chain, fourth gives about 75 km/h), brake capacities and the governor droop are assumptions. Reverse is not simulated.
brake_note: Hand brake first set to 800 N m per wheel: braking pitched the sprung body forward and locked the rear wheels (29% slide in the steered descents). Set to 500 N m, below lock; still twice the 5-degree holding torque and above fourth-gear drive.
